purposes.detail: Measured near/mid/far body and open-antler targets; retain rigid crown shape at every level.
purposes.normal_pixels: Bake dense coat, ceramic and shallow fracture detail into the source atlas.
purposes.breath_metres: Slow ordinary breathing with planted hooves.
purposes.stance_sink_metres: Settle the asymmetrical source stance into reachable targets without stretching leg bones.
purposes.step_metres: In-place stride review, not native movement speed.
purposes.hoof_lift_metres: Visible swing clearance while the stance hoof remains flat.
purposes.graze_neck_radians: Lower the muzzle to low understory (about half a metre) while the generated neck plates keep their shape; this is browsing, not a grass-level neck fold.
purposes.graze_head_counter_radians: Head counterrotation lets the muzzle lower while the rigid crown clears the floor.
purposes.turn_neck_radians: Small neck contribution to a look-around pose.
purposes.turn_head_radians: Separate skull turn for antler/neck clearance review.
purposes.weight_smoothing_passes: Diffuse abrupt spatial weight boundaries through connected skin while preserving the rigid skull/crown and planted sole anchors.
